people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.
translations.bsb: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it, exhausted yet still in pursuit.
